title: Space activated Peek may press the Pin Window Size button unintentionally
author: AkazaRenn

status.label: Open Peek fix already linked
status.detail: The live issue already cross-references an open upstream PR that explicitly closes this report and addresses the focused title-bar button startup behavior.

next_action.label: Track the linked upstream PR
next_action.reason: The issue already has a concrete active fix attempt and does not need a competing design.

judgment.rationale: Open PR #50472 explicitly closes this issue and describes the same startup focus leak: WinUI focuses the title-bar buttons when Peek opens, and pressing Space can trigger the Pin or Open-in-default-viewer buttons unintentionally.
evidence: The issue describes bare-Space activation toggling the Pin Window Size button and includes a screenshot showing the focused title-bar button.
The live issue timeline cross-references upstream PR #50472.
PR #50472 is open and non-draft and says it fixes title-bar button focus on startup, which is the exact mechanism reported here.
No newer issue comment or competing linked fix attempt changes the public state.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the issue as already handled by the linked upstream PR and avoid generating a second design or workaround.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is already a concrete upstream fix attempt for the reported Peek focus problem.

issue_context.summary: Peek can focus the Pin Window Size button on startup, and a Space-based activation can then toggle that control unintentionally. The live issue already has an open upstream PR for that exact behavior.
known_information: The reporter is on PowerToys v0.101.2211 from GitHub.
The issue is specific to Peek when activation mode is set to Spacebar.
The attached image shows the title-bar button focus rectangle.
The reporter proposes clearing focus on window show as the easiest fix.
inferences: The startup focus problem is already accepted enough to have an open upstream PR, so the right action is to follow that work rather than create duplicate design debt.
issue_context.analysis: Because the live issue already points at a concrete upstream PR with the same mechanism and scope, a fresh design artifact would not improve maintainers visibility or decision quality.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete issue body, attachments, labels, assignees, and empty comment thread.
Checked the timeline cross-reference to PR #50472 and inspected that PR summary, which explicitly describes the title-bar focus leak and unintended Space activation.
Confirmed there is no newer public comment contradicting the linked fix attempt.
